title: OBSERVATIONAL STUDY ON VIRAL SHEDDING AND IMMUNOLOGICAL RESPONSE OF OROPOUCHE VIRUS
official: OBSERVATIONAL STUDY ON VIRAL SHEDDING AND IMMUNOLOGICAL RESPONSE OF OROPOUCHE VIRUS
summary: This is a single-center observational study, whose primary objective is to describe the immune response to Oropouche Virus (OROV) during the study period and the duration of viral RNA shedding, only for sequential samples, by RT-PCR in different matrices.
sponsor: IRCCS Sacro Cuore Don Calabria di Negrar
